raw.query: SELECT window_name, lead_s, (SUM(CASE WHEN policy = 'forecast' THEN provisioned_worker_seconds ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN policy = 'reactive' THEN provisioned_worker_seconds ELSE 0 END) - 1.0) * 100.0 AS pct_increase FROM provenance.v_pool_cost WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'a2' AND source_relation = 'encoder_run_summary' AND ((window_name = 'burst3' AND lead_s = 30) OR (window_name = 'steady24h' AND lead_s = 165)) GROUP BY window_name, lead_s ORDER BY window_name;
raw.evidence: At L=30s, burst3 encoder cost is 32228.0s (forecast) vs 28355.8s (reactive), giving a +13.6558% (+13.7%) overhead. At L=165s, steady24h (calm day) encoder cost is 162055.8s (forecast) vs 142256.7s (reactive), giving a +13.9179% (+13.9%) overhead.
